arguments.name: type
arguments.description: CloudWatch service alias ("alb", "ec2", etc) or namespace name ("AWS/EC2", "AWS/S3", etc). Refer to supported-services for a complete list.

arguments.name: custom_tags
arguments.description: Custom tags to be added as a list of key / value pairs. When exported to Prometheus format, the label name follows the following format: custom_tag_{key}.

arguments.name: dimension_name_requirements
arguments.description: List of metric dimensions to query. Before querying metric values, the total list of metrics are filtered to only those that contain exactly this list of dimensions. An empty or undefined list results in all dimension combinations being included.

arguments.name: nil_to_zero
arguments.description: When true, NaN metric values are converted to 0. Individual metrics can override this value in the metric block.

arguments.name: recently_active_only
arguments.description: Only return metrics that have been active in the last 3 hours.

arguments.name: search_tags
arguments.description: List of key / value pairs to use for tag filtering (all must match). The value can be a regular expression.
